deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 9% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 35% last year; 25%/yr over 3 years — the market expects a slowdown from its recent pace.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 43% (3 years ago 12%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $43 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 38% (3 years ago 15%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $4.2B, up 243% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Inventory up 129% vs quarterly sales up 61% (days of inventory 79 → 112). Products may be building up unsold — a warning sign in chip cycles.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 25%/yr over 3 years and 22%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 20% vs a 5-year range of 1–20% (median 14%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $9.84, up 8% in 90 days (up 7% in the last 30); 24 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $7.19, up 7% in 90 days (up 7% in the last 30); 22 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.text: By segment, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Americas 69% of sales, up 75%; Asia Pacific 18% of sales, up 50%; Europe, Middle East & Africa 13% of sales, up 23%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.sub: +78% vs a year ago · $5.34 over 12 months (GAAP)

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +61% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $13.1B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 61% vs a year earlier and speeding up (from 30% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $20 of operating profit, up from $18 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 150% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 36× last year's profit (lower than 95% of the last 5 years); only 20× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.
